name: Namespace breakout via cgroups release_agent
description: Namespace breakout via cgroups release_agent -- a insane-tier linux challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Namespace breakout via cgroups release_agent"
